mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wechat_session (bot_id, user_id, bot_token, resume_json, saved_at) VALUES (#{botId}, #{userId}, #{botToken}, #{resumeJson}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), bot_token = VALUES(bot_token), resume_json = VALUES(resume_json), saved_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, bot_id, user_id, bot_token, resume_json, saved_at FROM wechat_session ORDER BY saved_at
mapper.update: UPDATE wechat_session SET saved_at = #{savedAt} WHERE bot_id = #{botId}
